verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents snapshots, which are tar archives of a collection's data and configuration. The engine is Apache-2.0 open source and self-hostable with local storage volumes, so users can take their data out and run it anywhere. However, the evidence shows only Qdrant-specific snapshot archives, not export of vectors and payloads into vendor-neutral formats (e.g., JSON, Parquet) for use in other systems. Snapshots are also scoped per collection per node. Missing for 10: documented export to open, tool-agnostic data formats; a bulk full-account or cluster-wide export path; independent corroboration of migrating off Qdrant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Snapshots are tar archive files that contain data and configuration of a specific collection on a specific node at a specific time.
